_comment: Schema of deployments/timelock-roles.<ENV>.json — the committed expected-holder manifest of the GOV-1
48h TimelockController that owns SuperPaymaster and Registry after runbook M1 (spec 03 §10.7b GOV-1/2).
THIS FILE IS AN EXAMPLE: every address below is a FAKE PLACEHOLDER (0x…FA4E…, 'FAKE'), and `_placeholder`
makes both checks refuse it. Create the real file for a network when its timelock is deployed (A5s on
Sepolia, A6 on OP mainnet), WITHOUT `_placeholder`, and change it only through a reviewed change.
EVERY field is required (a missing field is rejected, never read as an empty set):
network (non-empty), chainId (must equal the chain being operated on), timelock, deploymentBlock (the
block of the timelock CREATE: the constructor grants must be in it), roles.* (four non-empty arrays),
mustHoldNothing (non-empty, unique, non-zero) and mustHoldNothingLabels (one non-empty label each).
`roles` must be the M1 policy: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = [timelock] only; PROPOSER/CANCELLER/EXECUTOR = [Safe]
only (on live chains the Mycelium Safe 0x51eDf11fDb0A4F66220eFb8efA54Eca77232E114; no open executor).
`mustHoldNothing` = HISTORICAL accounts persisted here (deployer, old SP owner, old Registry owner, any
other known EOA), never derived from the proxies' current owner().
Both checks read it: UpgradeViaTimelock (parseManifest + validateManifest + m1Preflight, bounded) and
script/governance/check-timelock-roles.mjs (event history; rebuilds the FULL holder set of every role).
mustHoldNothingLabels: FAKE placeholder: previous SuperPaymaster / Registry owner
